If the filename is null or its strlen is zero, return 0.
Copy the filename into the stack buffer v16 and strip the extension by truncating the string at the last '.' (ASCII 46), if present.

Normalize the stripped path with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc; resolve the season path base from global dword_7D0434 or the default byte_5EA438 and normalize it too; then dispatch the file copy check via StringCopyFileCheckDispatch(filename, 0).

If the resolved season path differs from the default byte_5EA438: build a combined path buffer, format it with StringFormatProcessingWithNullTerm as "%s%s" from dword_5EC3D8 (or default) plus byte_5EA438, and look the combined path up via ObjectIDLookupAcross9Arrays.

Format a second combined path with StringFormatProcessingWithNullTerm as "%s%s" from dword_5EC3D8 (or default) plus the resolved dword_7D0434 (or default), and if formatting succeeds load and decode the audio file via AudioFileLoadDecode(path, 0).
Invoke vtable method at offset 28 (0x1C) on the this[16] sub-object (field 0x40) with argument 29, and again with argument 2, retrieving two sub-objects to finalize.
If the first retrieved sub-object is non-null, process it via sub_470190.
If the second retrieved sub-object is non-null, finalize it via loc_468640.
Return 1 to signal successful setup-file load and finalize.
